summary: DHT Holdings furnished a Form 6-K attaching an October 12, 2026 press release containing an ordinary quarterly business update, not a special situation. The company estimated Q3 2026 time charter equivalent earnings of $141,300 per day across the fleet, split between $167,100 per day for spot VLCCs and $114,200 per day for time-chartered VLCCs, based on 2,055 revenue days. For Q4 2026 to date, roughly 50% of available spot days are booked at about $509,100 per day, with 78% of revenue days at approximately $225,200 per day. No deal, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural mechanic is disclosed; this is routine disclosure and warrants no risk-arb angle.
